why.point_1_title: Real-time, even on an unstable network
why.point_1_text: Messaging, statuses, synchronization: Talky holds up when the connection drops and comes back.
why.point_2_text: Till, inventory, accounting: tools that stay usable without permanent internet.
why.point_3_text: Records, contributions, benefits: rigorous modeling, not a dressed-up spreadsheet.

process.subtitle: Five steps, one point of contact. At every moment you know where your project stands and what is left to do.
process.step_1_text: WhatsApp, email or the form. We clarify the business problem.
process.step_2_text: Scope, timeline and budget in writing, before the first line of code.
process.step_3_text: Visible iterations. You see progress, you approve it.
process.step_4_text: Go live, training, documentation that is actually useful.
process.step_5_text: Fixes, improvements, hosting if you want it.

about_page.intro: EVOLYX Digital builds websites, applications and business software for Cameroonian companies, French-speaking African businesses, and international clients.
about_page.group_text: The EVOLYX group covers several activities. EVOLYX Shop is the e-commerce arm. EVOLYX Digital builds the software: websites, applications, back-offices, business tools. This site is not a shop.
about_page.approach_title: We start from the problem, not the template
about_page.approach_text: Many agencies sell generic websites. We start from a concrete operation — inventory, records, till, messages — and deliver the tool that runs it, including when the network is unstable.
about_page.value_1_text: The portfolio shows products in use, not mockups. If a project is still in progress, we say so.
about_page.value_2_text: Scoping, development, delivery, maintenance: you are not passed from a salesperson to an anonymous freelancer.
about_page.value_3_text: French and English on the site, and in delivery, to work with both local and international teams.
